entity_identity_findings.finding: "Tour Fiji Tours" (vakaviti-kb.partners row op_tourfiji_001, domain tourfiji.tours) is very likely the SAME identity as fijitourtransfers.com, not a separate business.
entity_identity_findings.evidence: Every tour listing authored on fijitourtransfers.com attributes to WordPress author page /author/infotourfiji-tours/, displayed as 'Tour Fiji Tours'. The footer contact email is info@tourfiji.tours - the exact domain vakaviti-kb's partner row references.
entity_identity_findings.confidence: high, not certain (a shared inbox across two related-but-legally-separate businesses is still possible)
entity_identity_findings.resolves: the 'possible duplicate, unconfirmed' item flagged in Phase E1's supply-reconciliation.md - recommend upgrading to CONFIRMED once you verify directly.

entity_identity_findings.finding: fijitourtransfers.com's Organization structured data lists contact email helpronline@gmail.com - the same Google account that owns and operates this entire Cloudflare account (author_email on every single Worker/Pages deployment checked across this whole engagement).
entity_identity_findings.evidence: JSON-LD @graph Organization block on the jewels-of-fiji-tour product page: {"email":"helpronline@gmail.com", ...}. Compare to e.g. nadi-dispatch-api's deployment author_email, identical string, observed dozens of times across E1-E3F.
entity_identity_findings.resolves: TRUTH-003 (FTT operator vs marketplace identity) - concrete evidence that fijitourtransfers.com is commonly owned/operated with the rest of the ecosystem, not an independent third party. This is new evidence for the existing ceo-war-room/04-BRAND-ENTITY-MAP.md, which currently lists this relationship as a 'CEO DECISION' placeholder rather than a confirmed fact.

entity_identity_findings.finding: Three different postal addresses for the same business appear across fijitourtransfers.com's own surfaces: footer text says 'Nausori, Fiji' AND '113 Rouse Rd, Rouse Hill NSW 2155, Australia'; the page's own JSON-LD Organization/Place block says street '74', NSW postcode 2763 (Riverstone, not Rouse Hill/2155).
entity_identity_findings.resolves: new TRUTH candidate - not yet in ceo-war-room/05-COMMERCIAL-TRUTH-REGISTER.md, recommend adding as TRUTH-009.

ftt_evidence_reconciliation._note: Read-only audit of currently visible fijitourtransfers.com claims. Nothing was changed, removed, or imported into Vakaviti. Classification values: EVIDENCE_CONFIRMED, NEEDS_SOURCE, CONTRADICTORY, EXPIRED, UNKNOWN.

items.claim: Per-tour discount badges (e.g. '-15%', '-60%', '-30%', '-50%', '-40%', '-10%') with a struck-through 'from' price alongside a lower current price
items.example: Natadola Beach Combinational Horse Riding Fiji: AU$250 struck through, 'From AU$100', badged -60%
items.reasoning: No price-history evidence is available to confirm AU$250 was ever a real transacted or listed price rather than an inflated anchor set alongside the 'sale' price from day one. Cannot classify as CONTRADICTORY (no direct contradiction observed) or CONFIRMED (no independent source checked).

items.claim: Per-tour star ratings and review counts (e.g. '4.9 (7 Reviews)', '5 (5 Reviews)', '4.8 (10 Reviews)')
items.reasoning: Individually small, per-product numbers are structurally more plausible than the old nadiairporttransfers.com v0.17 site's single blanket '500 reviews' claim (already flagged and removed upstream, see E3E), but no independent review-platform source (Google, TripAdvisor) was checked to confirm these counts are real and not seeded/fabricated at product-creation time by the booking plugin.
No licence number, issuing authority, or verification link is shown anywhere on the page. Matches ceo-war-room TRUTH-006 exactly (business trust claims unverified in war room).

items.claim: TravelAgency structured data: "Fiji's largest tour and transfer booking platform... Zero commission. Direct Fijian operator pricing. Free hotel transfers included with every tour."
items.reasoning: Four separate superlative/absolute claims ('largest', 'zero commission', 'direct... pricing', 'every tour') with no supporting evidence found on the page itself. 'Every tour' is checked against only one product page in this pass, so it cannot yet be confirmed OR contradicted at scale.

items.claim: Structured data currenciesAccepted: "FJD, AUD, NZD, USD" vs. visible product pricing shown exclusively in AU$ on every listing observed
items.reasoning: Directly observed on the same page: the visible UI never once displays a price in FJD, NZD or USD, only AUD, while the machine-readable structured data claims four currencies are accepted. This is a direct AI Visibility Standard violation (visible content must match structured data).

items.claim: Business address - three different values across footer text (x2) and JSON-LD Organization/Place data (x1) on the same site
items.reasoning: See entity_identity_findings above - 'Nausori, Fiji' / '113 Rouse Rd, Rouse Hill NSW 2155' / structured-data '74 [street], NSW 2763' cannot all be correct simultaneously for one PostalAddress claim.

items.claim: Product page 'Included/Excluded' description vs. FAQ description on the same Jewels of Fiji tour page
items.reasoning: Included/Excluded text describes a boat ride, waterfall swim, bamboo rafting, village visit and buffet lunch. The FAQ block on the identical page describes a different itinerary entirely (Nadi Town market, Garden of the Sleeping Giant, Sigatoka Sand Dunes, Beqa Island firewalking, Navua River canoe tour, Mamanuca snorkelling). These read as two different tours' content merged onto one page - likely a templating/content-population defect, not necessarily intentional misrepresentation, but a real customer-facing inconsistency.
A 'Cancellation options' link exists in the site footer but was not opened in this pass (out of scope for the one product page inspected in depth); no cancellation terms were read or verified.

WooCommerce Square payment gateway plugin assets (wc-square-cart-checkout-blocks.css) are genuinely present and loaded on the live product page - this is a real, technically-confirmed integration, not a claim requiring further sourcing. Scope limit: the specific Square catalog/item/location identifier was not extracted, since doing so would require proceeding further into the checkout flow than the read-only constraint allows.
